title: Record ADR 0017's approval in full (D23), audit its implementation and tighten the fallback-width test
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Decision D23: the Director approved ADR 0017 in its entirety, with the icon and font guidelines (D20, D21) governing where they differ, and required it implemented in full; this corrects D22's reading of 'other changes'. ADR 0017's status line and interpretations section record the approval.

Implementation audit of every ADR 0017 decision item, interpretation and consequence against the code, recorded as a table in the ADR: all implemented; the authored icon family is superseded by D21; animation speed is bounded in the preference model as the ADR states, and applying it to choreography belongs to packages/presentation (§32).

The ADR's font-metrics consequence (about 4.5% width difference) was a Linux hinting artifact: with hinting off the measured fallback is within +1.2% of Source Sans 3 (639.5 px against 631.9 px; hinted 622 px against 651 px). The browser test bound tightens from 5% to 2%.
RUN-20261021-005 (configuration and workflow checks, pnpm audit clean, typecheck, lint, full suite: 403 Node, 26 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection) passes at fingerprint 52f4cc01.
RUN-20261021-006: isolated design-system suite passed in 117 s (34 gates, Chromium install, 161/161, including the tightened 2% width bound) at fingerprint 52f4cc01.
